name: Manufacturing
description: For a small plant (20 to 50 people): production log with the OEE inputs, downtime with reasons, quality inspections with defects and NCRs with an approval, maintenance requests with routing and escalation, preventive maintenance plans and tasks, shift handovers. Phone apps for operators, inspectors and technicians (scan the machine QR code, work offline, photos, signatures), desktop apps for supervisors, quality, maintenance and setup, three dashboards on the built-in OEE measures, six print templates and ten flows. Shifts, downtime reasons and defect types come as reference rows; SAMPLE rows of a fictional press shop are optional.

flows.name: Raise an NCR for a failed inspection
flows.description: An inspection saved with the result Fail creates an NCR (status Open, action due in 7 days) and tells the quality role.

then.name: TellQuality
then.title: "NCR " & Steps.Ncr.Output.Slot_NCRs_Number & ": inspection " & Trigger.Record.Slot_Inspections_Number & " failed"
then.body: "Batch " & Coalesce(Trigger.Record.Slot_Inspections_Batch, "-") & ". Choose a disposition and send it for approval in the Quality desk."

flows.name: NCR disposition approval
flows.description: An NCR sent for approval asks the quality head; the answer and comment are written back on the NCR.

flows.name: Breakdown creates a maintenance request
flows.description: A stoppage with the reason Breakdown creates a high-priority maintenance request for the machine and links it to the stoppage.

flows.name: Route and escalate a maintenance request
flows.description: A new request goes to the machine's technician (or every person with the Maintenance role); if nobody acknowledges it in 30 minutes, the plant manager is told and it is marked escalated.

then.name: TellTechnician
then.title: "Breakdown: " & Trigger.Record.Slot_MaintenanceRequests_Machine & " (" & Trigger.Record.Slot_MaintenanceRequests_Number & ")"
then.body: Trigger.Record.Slot_MaintenanceRequests_Problem & ". Acknowledge it in the Maintenance app."

then.name: TellMaintenance
then.title: "Breakdown: " & Trigger.Record.Slot_MaintenanceRequests_Machine & " (" & Trigger.Record.Slot_MaintenanceRequests_Number & ")"
then.body: Trigger.Record.Slot_MaintenanceRequests_Problem & ". Acknowledge it in the Maintenance app."

flows.name: External repair cost approval
flows.description: An external repair above Rs 25,000 (cost approval Pending) asks the plant manager; the answer is written back.

flows.name: Create preventive maintenance tasks
flows.description: Every day at 06:00 (India time) a task is created for each active plan that is due, and the plan's next due date moves on.

flows.name: Daily OEE PDF to the plant managers
flows.description: Every day at 07:00 (India time) the daily OEE summary of yesterday is made as a PDF and emailed to every person with the Plant manager role (needs an Email connection in this environment).

steps.name: Mail
steps.subject: "Daily OEE " & Steps.OeePdf.Output.FileName
steps.body:
"

Good morning. The production and OEE summary of yesterday is attached.

Appbuilder, Manufacturing pack

"

flows.name: Remind owners of overdue NCR actions
flows.description: Every working day at 09:30 (India time) the owner of each NCR whose action is overdue is reminded.

flows.name: Tell the next supervisor about a handover
flows.description: A new shift handover notifies the supervisor it is handed to.

steps.name: TellNext
steps.title: "Shift handover: shift " & Trigger.Record.Slot_ShiftHandovers_Shift & " of " & Text(Trigger.Record.Slot_ShiftHandovers_HandoverDate, "dd/mm/yyyy")

printTemplates.name: Daily OEE summary
printTemplates.description: The built-in daily production and OEE summary over the pack's production log, for yesterday (the morning email).

footer.left: OEE = availability × performance × quality = good × ideal cycle / planned time (sums over the rows)

body.text: Daily production and OEE — {FormatDate(DateAdd(Today(), -1, "Days"), "d MMMM yyyy")}

items.label: OEE
items.value: If(Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_PlannedMin) > 0, Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin) / Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_PlannedMin), 0) * If(Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin) > 0, Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_IdealCycleSec * (Slot_ProductionLog_Good + Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap) / 60) / Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin), 0) * If(Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_Good + Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap) > 0, Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_Good) / Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_Good + Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap), 0)

items.label: Availability
items.value: If(Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_PlannedMin) > 0, Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin) / Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_PlannedMin), 0)

items.label: Performance
items.value: If(Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin) > 0, Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_IdealCycleSec * (Slot_ProductionLog_Good + Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap) / 60) / Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin), 0)

items.label: Quality
items.value: If(Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_Good + Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap) > 0, Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_Good) / Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_Good + Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap), 0)

values.name: OEE
values.value: 100 * If(Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_PlannedMin) > 0, Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin) / Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_PlannedMin), 0) * If(Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin) > 0, Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_IdealCycleSec * (Slot_ProductionLog_Good + Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap) / 60) / Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin), 0) * If(Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_Good + Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap) > 0, Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_Good) / Sum(Rows, Slot_ProductionLog_Good + Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap), 0)

values.name: OEE
values.value: Round(100 * If(ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_PlannedMin > 0, ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin / ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_PlannedMin, 0) * If(ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin > 0, (ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_IdealCycleSec * (ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Good + ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap) / 60) / ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin, 0) * If(ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Good + ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap > 0, ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Good / (ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Good + ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap), 0), 1)

columns.value: If(ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_PlannedMin > 0, ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin / ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_PlannedMin, 0) * If(ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin > 0, (ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_IdealCycleSec * (ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Good + ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap) / 60) / ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_RunMin, 0) * If(ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Good + ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap > 0, ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Good / (ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Good + ThisItem.Slot_ProductionLog_Scrap), 0)

roles.name: Operator
roles.description: Logs production and stoppages on the shop floor; sees only the rows they wrote; reports breakdowns (without the repair cost).

roles.name: Supervisor
roles.description: Runs a shift: the production and downtime of their team, work orders, shift handovers; reads quality and maintenance.

roles.name: Quality
roles.description: Inspectors and the quality head: inspections, defects, NCRs (the disposition approval goes to the quality role), inspection plans and defect types.

roles.name: Maintenance
roles.description: Technicians and the maintenance in-charge: requests, preventive plans and tasks, machine status.

roles.name: Plant manager
roles.description: Reads everything of the plant, keeps the masters (lines, machines, shifts, reasons), approves external repairs above the limit.

sequences.name: Work orders
sequences.description: Production work orders (numbers restart each financial year, April to March).
